name: PM-USP Special Scholarship Scheme for the Students of UTs of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh (SSS J&K and Ladakh, formerly PMSSS)
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education (implemented by AICTE)

rules.quote: Candidates should be domicile of Union Territories of J&K and Ladakh.

rules.value: class 12 from JKBOSE/CBSE school in J&K or Ladakh
rules.quote: Students must have passed 12 th examination from JKBOSE or CBSE affiliated schools located in UTs of J&K and Ladakh.
Having family income of Rs. 8.00 Lakh or less per annum.
secure admission in Government colleges/institutions and other select institutions outside the UTs of J&K and Ladakh through AICTE’s counselling process
Candidates pursuing Post-Graduate level studies, in any discipline.
Candidates pursing courses through Open Universities. (ii) Student availing benefit of any other scholarship Scheme

rules.value: apply on AICTE portal, document verification at facilitation centre
rules.quote: Candidates are compulsorily required to apply online on the AICTE web-portal and verify their documents through nearest Facilitation Centers of J&K and Ladakh within time frame
STUDENTS ENROLED IN NATIONAL SCHOLARSHIP PORTAL (NSP) AS A BENEFICIARY AND/OR ALREADY AVAILING SCHOLARSHIP ARE NOT ELIGIBLE FOR THE SSSJKL

amount.text: Academic fee up to Rs 30,000 (general), Rs 1.25 lakh (professional/engineering), Rs 3 lakh (medical) plus fixed maintenance allowance Rs 1 lakh per annum
amount.quote: upper ceiling of Academic Fee inclusive of all admissible components taken together is Rs. 1.25 Lakh for Professional / Engineering Stream; Rs. 30,000/- for General Stream and Rs. 3.00 Lakh for Medical Stream

documents.name: Domicile certificate of UT of J&K or Ladakh
documents.quote: Certificate of domicile of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir or Ladakh

documents.name: Class 12 and 10 certificates / diploma certificate
documents.quote: Certificate of Class 12 th and 10 th Examination (for candidates who have passed class 12 th examination)

documents.name: Income certificate from UT competent authority
documents.quote: Income Certificate issued by the competent authority of UT of Jammu & Kashmir or UT of Ladakh.

documents.name: Caste / disability certificate where applicable
documents.quote: Students applying under reserved quota must produce Caste Certificate (SC/ST/SEBC/EWS) issued by Union Territory Authorities.

deadline.text: NSP 2026-27 lists this scheme for renewal only; student application close 31-10-2026 (registers/nsp_central_2026_27.csv)
